title: Amico, per pietà
subtitle: Leporello, Zerlina and Donna Elvira: recitative from Don Giovanni, Act 2

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 232–233 (33 bars)
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages by one reader, checked bar by bar by a separate fresh checker, then checked again against the print here; every bar of every part adds up. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Secco recitative: the keyboard is written as the piano. Playback tempo: free, as recitative is sung; played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 91, estimated: the median pace of the seven Act 2 recitatives already timed from recordings. This scene was added for the Vienna performances of 1788 and is left out of the recordings consulted (Fricsay 1959, Davis 1973).
